readme_head: # League List A single-page application that consumes the [TheSportsDB](https://www.thesportsdb.com/free_sports_api) API to display sports leagues with filtering, search, and season badge lookup. [Live Demo](https://league-list.jhookc.net) ## Screenshots ### Desktop — Dark Mode ![Dark mode desktop view](docs/screenshots/dark-mode-desktop.png) ### Desktop — Light Mode ![Light mode desktop view](docs/screenshots/light-mode-desktop.png) ### Desktop — Badge Modal ![Badge modal on desktop](docs/screenshots/badge-modal-desktop.png) ### Mobile View ### Mobile — Badge Bottom Sheet ## Getting Started ```bash pnpm install pnpm dev ``` Open [http://localhost:5173](http://localhost:5173) in your browser. ### Scripts | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `pnpm dev` | Start development server | | `pnpm build` | Type-check and build for production | | `pnpm preview` | Preview production build | | `pnpm lint` | Lint and format with Biome | | `pnpm typecheck` | Run TypeScript type checks | ## Tech Stack - **React 19** with TypeScript 5.9 - **Vite 7** for bundling and HMR - **Tailwind CSS v4** with CSS custom properties for theming - **TanStack Query** for data fetching and caching - **TanStack Virtual** for list virtualization - **Fuse.js** for fuzzy search (lazy-loaded) - **Biome** for linting and formatting ## Architecture ``` src/ api/ # API client and query functions assets/icons/ # SVG icon components data/ # Sample data and mock enrichment features/ badge/ # Season badge modal and bottom sheet carousel/ # Hero carousel with auto-rotation discovery/ # Recent wins ticker leagues/ # League list, filters, context, hooks shared/ components/ # Button, Dropdown, Modal, BottomSheet, etc. hooks/ # useDebounce, useTheme, useMediaQuery, etc. constants.ts # Shared constants ``` The app uses a **feature-based architecture** where each domain (badge, carousel, leagues) owns its components, hooks, and types. Shared UI primitives live in `shared/components`. State flows through a centralized `LeagueContext` that composes three hooks: `useLeagues` (data fetching), `useLeagueFilters` (search, sort, sport filter), and `useFavorites` (localStorage persistence). This keeps the component tree clean — any component can access league state without prop drilling. ## Core Requirements - **League list** — Fetches all leagues from TheSportsDB API and displays `strLeague`, `strSport`, and `strLeagueAlternate` in a card-based list. - **Search** — Debounced text input with fuzzy matching via Fuse.js. Searches across league name, sport, and alternate name. - **Sport filter** — Dropdown dynamically populated from the API response. Uses a compound component pattern for the dropdown. - **Badge lookup** — Clicking a league calls the Season Badge API and displays the badge image in a modal (desktop) or bottom sheet (mobile). - **Response caching** — TanStack Query caches all API responses with a 5-minute `staleTime` for live API data and `Infinity` for sample data. ## Extra Features - **Dark mode** — Toggle between light and dark themes.
